messages:
Aisha (CEO): Quick follow-up from today — thanks for the great questions in the meeting. I wanted to open a live thread for any clarifying Qs about how the roadmap maps to our mission and where we draw the product/company boundaries. Drop short Qs and we’ll answer live.
Jules (Product): Nice — will do. First quick one: when product docs say 'unified runtime', how much of that is UX vs hard wiring in the backend? like, is it an API contract or we also promise migration tooling?
Aisha (CEO): Short answer: both. API contract always first-class; migration/tooling is a product priority for Dedicated -> Private flows. Expect a migration CLI + runbook in the next quarter.
Tom (CTO): For engineers: to set expectations — we are not promising zero-downtime model swaps across all configs day-one. The plan is canary + automatic fallback for compatible variants. Rollout timeline: canary infra this quarter, full rollout tooling next quarter.
Ravi (Growth): On GTM: how do we differentiate vs big cloud ML endpoints? Customers ask if Redwood is just another hosting lane.
Aisha (CEO): We lean into economics and operational guarantees. Cloud endpoints sell scale; we sell predictable per-token economics, routing/fallback policies, and ops primitives (batching, KV-cache) tuned for production workloads. Also the sales motion: self-serve for Hosted, sales-assist triggering at Dedicated usage thresholds.
Morgan (Eng): Quick infra question: for Private (VPC/on-prem) — timeline for HSM/KMS integration + audit log retention controls? Some enterprise deals are blocked on this.
Tom (CTO): Timeline: basic KMS integration (customer-managed keys) in 3 weeks; HSM/HW-backed KMS in ~2 months. Audit log retention controls (configurable retention windows) by end of quarter. We’ll post a public timeline in the infra tracker.
Jules (Product): Are we changing pricing/packaging to make Dedicated easier to adopt? Several customers said commitment sizing is a blocker.
Aisha (CEO): We’re testing a flexible burst tier — reserved baseline + burst credits — to reduce the initial commitment. Pilot by select customers next month.
Ravi (Growth): Any guidance we can share with AE/SEs today to address 'why Redwood vs self-hosting open inference runtimes'?
Aisha (CEO): Messaging to use: 1) Time-to-production: infra + routing + monitoring out-of-the-box, 2) Unit economics: batching + cache optimizations reduce per-token cost vs naive self-host, 3) Reliability: fallback policies and SLA-backed Dedicated. I’ll share a one-pager for AE/SEs by EOD Monday.
Tom (CTO): For the engineering folks asking about model support: we’ll prioritize first-class support (quantized kernels, optimized KV cache) for the top 5 community models customers use. If you have enterprise requests, tag the model in #eng-ml.
Morgan (Eng): Re: KV cache — small ask: can we expose a perf dashboard per-model showing cache hit ratio? would help debug regressions.
Tom (CTO): Yep — action item for Observability team. Target: per-model cache hit rate + cost-savings estimate in console. ETA: 6 weeks.
Jules (Product): A couple customers asked about multi-tenant vs single-tenant guaranteed isolation for Dedicated — can we give a crisp answer?
Aisha (CEO): Dedicated is single-tenant compute and isolation; Hosted is multi-tenant. We also provide network isolation and data retention SLAs for Dedicated customers. If Compliance asks for air-gapped, we offer Private on-prem.
Ravi (Growth): Competitors question: any changes to how we talk about 'cost-aware controls' vs competitors?
Aisha (CEO): Emphasize the levers we provide (batching, quantization profiles, routing policies) plus the tooling that quantifies impact. Not just 'we do less cost' but 'here's the knob and the numbers'.
All-Hands Bot: Follow-up doc posted — https://internal.redwood/collab/mission-roadmap-playbook (internal).
Aisha (CEO): Thanks — last note: small ask from leadership: if you have blockers that stop deals or deployments, ping me or @Tom with a one-line summary + urgency. We’ll prioritize critical path items. :thumbsup:
Jules (Product): Ack. Will collate asks and share a short list by Wednesday.
Morgan (Eng): Thanks — I’ll add the KV dashboard spec to the infra tracker.
Ravi (Growth): Will forward key AE questions I hear this week.
Tom (CTO): We’ll post the canary rollout playbook next Tuesday.
Aisha (CEO): Great thread — appreciate the short Qs. If anyone wants a quick 1:1 to dig into a specific customer, DM me.
All-Hands Bot: Thread locked for updates — please follow the pinned doc for ongoing status.
